key_findings.critical_correction_to_task_description: Enriching successorBirthContent ALONE makes keyLowerBd's minting case FALSE, not merely hard. The obligation is `successorBirthContent ⊆ relevantSetFinset (newForms ++ b) (modalNextWorld b)`, and relevantSetFinset is literal branch membership. Adding (pos, box psi) to the key requires T(box psi)@w' to be ON the branch at mint time. modalApplyOne's boxNeg/diamondPos arms emit only the UNWRAPPED forms. The mint payload must change in the same landing; the task description's 'keys and mint payload both change here' is correct and is a hard requirement, not a convenience.
key_findings.rules_lean_must_not_be_edited: modalApplyOne is shared by K/T/B/S5 drivers and by FmpMeasure.lean's _gen lemmas; boxed transmission is not K-sound. The boxed arm belongs in modalApplyOneS4Keyed, replacing its two `| none => modalApplyOne sf b acc` fallthroughs.
key_findings.both_members_beats_boxed_only: The prior-art variant in specs/553_.../artifacts/s4boxed.lean REPLACES (pos, psi) with (pos, box psi). That would falsify blockedRedirect_unwrapped_boxPos_mem and blockedRedirect_unwrapped_diaNeg_mem, two landed sorry-free lemmas explicitly retained for the route (1) successor plan. Task E's both-members reading is a strict superset and preserves them. Prefer the task's reading over the 553 report's sbcBoxed.
key_findings.box_plus_is_free_in_the_world_bound_CONF: modalSubfmls (.box a) = .box a :: modalSubfmls a (FmpMeasure.lean, def modalSubfmls) means box psi is in modalSubfmls phi0 whenever T(box psi)@w is on b (subset of modalUniverseS4 phi0). The enriched key stays inside signedSubfmls phi0, so signedSubfmls_card_le, signedSubfmls_powerset_card_le, modalWorldBoundS4 and the pigeonhole chain are untouched.
key_findings.boxPlusClosed_naming_trap: A universally quantified `forall p in k, boxPlusPair p in k` is FALSE. The witness pair (s, phi) enters by `insert` and neither closure direction holds for it (mint from F(box(box chi))@w has witness (neg, box chi) with neither (neg, chi) nor (neg, dia box chi) on the branch at birth). BoxPlusClosed MUST be scoped to the transmitted box-context filter. Report section 5.2 gives a provable shape.
key_findings.additive_mint_shape_is_worth_20_proof_bo: Emit modalApplyOne's own payload `++ boxPlusExtraS4`, not an interleaved rewrite. Every existing membership proof into the payload is a List.mem_append_left / List.mem_cons_of_mem chain into the original list; under `old ++ extra` each survives with one extra wrapper, under a rewrite each must be re-derived.

live_guard_corpus_sweep.verdict: R2 CLOSED, and favourably. Box-plus decides 84 MORE formulas within the same fuel and regresses none. Mechanism: blockingWorldS4 requires relevantSetFinset = successorBirthContent as an EQUALITY; an unwrapped-only birth content can never equal a matured world's live relevant set, because the 4-rule has by then added the boxed pairs there. Enriching the key makes the equality reachable, so blocking fires more reliably and fewer worlds are minted.
live_guard_corpus_sweep.audit_note: The open_to_closed / closed_to_open counters ignore fuel-exhausted rows by construction, so a none->closed row would slip past them -- that is exactly where an unsound closure would hide. It was audited separately and is 0.

implementer_pitfalls: Do NOT rewrite the existing two filter disjuncts into boxPlusPair form. The Or.inl <rfl, _> / Or.inr <rfl, _> steps in blockedRedirect_unwrapped_boxPos_mem, blockedRedirect_unwrapped_diaNeg_mem and both successorBirthContent_*_subset_relevantSetFinset match the current syntactic shape. Append two disjuncts; note the reformulation in the docstring only.

Do NOT convert the whole filter predicate to Bool form -- it breaks the same four proofs. Keep the Prop-valued disjunction and make the new disjuncts decidable by matching on p.2 rather than by an existential.

Do NOT add BoxPlusClosed as an S4LoopInv or S4KeyedHintikkaInv field. modalTableauS4Keyed_initial (FrameCompleteness.lean) uses a positional refine with 10 + 5 holes and will break. Thread it as an extra hypothesis, the same treatment keysOriginS4 and keysRootEmpty already receive.
Do NOT edit Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/Rules.lean. modalApplyOne is shared with K/T/B/S5.
Keep the per-formula `if b.any (. == sf') then none else some sf'` dedup guard in boxPlusExtraS4 -- modalApplyOneS4Keyed_persistentFresh_S4 and the measure argument both key off it.
modalApplyOneS4Keyed_persistentFresh_S4 looks like Class B but is Class A: it constrains only .persistent results and the mint is .linear, so its mint arms merely derive .linear != .persistent.

successorBirthContent's `insert (s, phi)` head must be preserved verbatim -- modalStepBranchS4Keyed_blocked_witness_mem is a one-line Finset.mem_insert_self consequence and is what keeps eBoxNegWitness/eDiamondPosWitness alive through the blocked case.
